title: inspect_material specification
description: Optional knobs for materials.inspect_material (read a UMaterial or UMaterialInstanceConstant into ADR-0004 MaterialGraph JSON + parameter inventory). Target asset path lives on the envelope target when known; otherwise use query/asset_name. Owned by WS-08.

query.description: AssetRegistry name/substring search for UMaterial / UMaterialInstanceConstant when target.asset_path is omitted (e.g. M_Free_Spells_Flash, Free_Spells).

asset_name.description: Alias for query — exact or substring asset name under search_root.

search_root.description: Package path root for query resolution (e.g. /Game or a Free_Spells folder).

include_expression_graph.description: When true and the asset is a UMaterial master, include result.graphs[] MaterialGraph (nodes/links/property inputs).

include_parameters.description: Include scalar/vector/texture/static_switch parameter inventory with current values.

include_property_inputs.description: Include MP_* material property wiring (emissive, opacity, base color, …) under extensions.material.property_inputs.

response_detail.description: Overrides envelope options.response_detail. Inspect defaults to complete when omitted.
